{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is positive, forecast prices must be above both recent mean and model baseline to avoid undershooting",
    "Negative sentiment requires prices to dip below recent lows faster than model predicts, avoiding delayed reaction",
    "Detect and correct mean-reversion bias when prices stabilize within 2% of historical ranges for more than 5 days",
    "Sentiment strength correlation: very strong positive (1.0) requires 3-5% above baseline on day 1, strong negative (-1.0) requires 3-5% below baseline",
    "When price momentum diverges from sentiment signal for 3+ days, align forecast with price action until convergence",
    "Correct vertical offset bias by adjusting day 1-7 prices by sentiment intensity factor (0 to 1)",

    "Identify and remove lag by accelerating sentiment-driven price changes in first 10 days of forecast, returning to baseline after"
] }
